title: Missing, Presumed Death
start: Speak to Brother Samwell in Silvarea, west of Paterdomus, east of Varrock.

recommended.t: Wicked hood, activated Draynor lodestone, or Traveller's necklace to teleport to the Wizards' Tower
Skeletal horror Teleport, activated Fort Forinthry lodestone, Archaeology journal, Dig Site pendant, or earth altar teleport to get to Brother Samwell and the Odd Old Man

kills.t: 11 Wights, wight rangers, and wight footsoldiers (scaled combat stats)

rewards.t: Mask of Sliske, Light/Mask of Sliske, Shadow cosmetic headgears
Invitation box, used to teleport to the Empyrean Citadel

steps.t: Speak to Brother Samwell (west of Paterdomus and east of Varrock). [Chat: ~ › ~ › Accept]
Search for the following clues.

sub.t: Investigate northernmost slaughtered monk. [Chat: 2 Investigate torso.]
Investigate nearby plant (east of the chest).
Investigate the tree with the arrow stuck in it (south of him).

p: Brother Samwell and the dead monks

steps.t: Talk to Brother Samwell. [Chat: 2 I think I've found all the clues. › Any]
Up the limestone quarry, speak to Odd Old Man. [Chat: 2 Ask about the slaughtered monks. › 1 Persuade him. › 1 Persuade him. › 2 Threaten him.]
Talk to Brother Samwell. [Chat: 1 He saw an elf heading east along the path. › 1 He saw a very tall, dark, hooded figure escaping. › Any]
Search for additional clues by following the crystals to the east.

sub.t: Investigate the killed elf ranger (southeast of the Temple). [Chat: 1 Investigate arms. › 4 Listen to the trapped soul.]
Investigate the plant west of her, near the middle pile of crystals next to the stairs, to receive a necklace.
Investigate the fence with blue clothing, to the south of the tree.

steps.t: Talk to Blaze Sharpeye by the beacon. [Chat: 2 Ask about the murdered elf. › 2 Threaten him. › 2 Threaten him. › 1 Persuade him.]
Return to Brother Samwell. [Chat: 2 I think I've found all the clues. › Any]

Go to the Wizards' Tower and speak to Wizard Valina inside the entry way on the lectern. [Chat: 2 I was told by Brother Samwell that you might be able to help us. › 1 Ask about the elves. › 2 Ask about Saradominist wizards. › Any › 3 Ask about teleportation.]
p: Fighting the Wights with Icthlarin by your side

steps.t: Return to Brother Samwell. [Chat: Any › 5 I think somebody else did this.]

Learn from Icthlarin about Death's disappearance. [Chat: Any › 2 Someone killed these people. › 1 Why does this concern you? › 1 Is everyone who dies trapped now? › 4 Continue. › 1 I'm ready to help.]
Defeat attacking wights.
Finish the conversation with Icthlarin. [Chat: Any › Any]
While standing next to Icthlarin, open the invitation box. [Chat: 1 We must, Death needs our help.]
Once in the citadel, talk to Icthlarin. [Chat: 1 I want to continue to the citadel.] A cutscene will play.
Enter the door to the west then north to the window to watch another cutscene.
Walk out the southeast window; jump the gap; run across the planks; drop down the rocks; climb up the rock face; walk in the western window.
Climb through the obstacle to the north.
Open the north door, then continue north into the next room.
Pull all three levers in the room (on the west, south, and east walls) to create light.
Lead all the wights that spawn (a group of 3, then 4) into the light to be able to damage them.
View the east window for another cutscene.
Open the door to the north, then continue east into the next room.

Use the viewing panel. [Chat: 3 Stop wasting my time. › 2 What do I do? › Any], then rotate the bottom-left machine once, the top-left one twice, the top-right three times and the bottom-right machine once.
View the south window for another cutscene.
Open the door to the east, then continue south into the next room.
Talk to the statue of Death. [Chat: 2 Get to the point. › Any › 3 How do I answer?]
Open the chest and take the correct item, then place on the answer plinth pedestal.

sub.t: First chest (east) [Chat: 3 Take sand.], place on answer plinth. [Chat: 1 Yes, final answer.]
Second chest (middle) [Chat: 2 Take water.], place on answer plinth. [Chat: 1 Yes, final answer.]
Second chest, again [Chat: 1 Take Shadow.], place on answer plinth. [Chat: 1 Yes, final answer.]

steps.t: View the west window for another cutscene.
Open the south door, then jump off the drop.
Speak to one of the Barrows brothers to enter the main room. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
p: The followers of the gods gather outside the citadel.

steps.t: After a cutscene, walk forward to continue talking with the Gods. [Chat: 1 Let Sliske carry on with his show. › Any › Any › Any]
Run around rear of other gods and stamp out the smaller flames on the ground to reach Death's cage while avoiding the fireballs from Strisath. Free him from his cage.

sub.t: The flames might be difficult to see with low graphics settings, especially with shadows turned off.

p: Death teleports you and Icthlarin away, just in time to avoid Strisath's fireball.

steps.t: Run back behind Icthlarin.

sub.t: Getting hit by the fireballs will reset your progress.

steps.t: Speak to Icthlarin.
Speak with Brother Samwell.
Quest complete!
